article.title: Guest Episode: Fran Quigley's "We Can Do Better" on the Arms Industry
article.author: Religious Socialism Podcast
article.content: This is a guest episode from Fran Quigley's podcast, "We Can Do Better." He discusses the way the arms industry has captured our political and economic life with Stephen Semler. If you like the episode, please consider subscribing to the We Can Do Better podcast, and sign up for the Substack newsletter: https://endpovertynow.substack.com/ Check out Fran's book, "Religious Socialism" along with several other recommended readings on our website: https://religioussocialism.org/recommended-reading/
